title: Platform Reliability Coordination — Sprint One-Pager
summary: Concise coordination plan for a 6-week cross-functional sprint to operationalize SLOs for a prioritized set of model-serving routes, align telemetry, and deliver runbooks + rollout checklist to feature teams.
objectives: Define and agree on 3 service-level objectives (latency P95, availability, error-rate) for model-serving routes used by Hosted API
Establish baseline telemetry and dashboards for SLO tracking (initial 30-day lookback), identify gaps
Produce runbooks, canary rollout checklist, and ownership handoff for two pilot services
Create a repeatable template and lightweight onboarding flow for feature teams to adopt SLOs
scope_included: Hosted API route group A (inference-text, chat-stream)
Telemetry: tracing, token-latency histograms, error classification, availability pings
Rollout artifacts: canary thresholds, automation playbooks, alert configs
scope_excluded: Model architecture-level performance tuning (handled by serving-runtime team)
Long-term tooling rewrites (this sprint focuses on pragmatic adapters)
milestones: Week 0: Kickoff + discovery workshop (alignment on goals, invite SRE/serving-runtime/product/observability)
Week 1: Telemetry inventory + quick gaps list (owner: Marisol Ramos)
Week 2: Draft SLO proposals and threshold candidates; agree on measurement primitives (owner: Liam Chen)
Week 3: Implement quick telemetry adapters & dashboards; synthetic tests for availability (owner: Ethan Boyd)
Week 4: Pilot runbook + automated canary for pilot service X; tabletop run-throughs with oncall (owner: Priya Singh)
Week 5: Feature-team handoff + tweak SLOs from feedback; finalize alerting and escalation paths
Week 6: Post-launch 30-day monitoring plan and retrospective items; publish template & onboarding doc
success_criteria: Three SLOs agreed and codified in the SLO registry for pilot routes
Dashboards showing SLO burn rates with 24h and 7d views
Two pilot services completed canary rollouts using the checklist and no customer-impacting incidents in 14 days
Runbooks published and acknowledged by oncall leads
Template and onboarding doc reused by at least one other feature team within 8 weeks
communication_plan: Weekly 30-min cross-functional sync (Mon 10:00) — short status + blockers
Ad-hoc Slack channel (#plat-reliability-sprint) for async questions and decisions
Critical decisions captured in decision log on Confluence (linked_artifacts[0])
End-of-sprint demo + ship notes recorded and distributed to stakeholders
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Observability gaps prevent accurate measurement of proposed SLOs; Mitigation: implement synthetic probes and fallback histograms for first-pass measurement
Risk: Serving-runtime changes required to emit token-latency histograms; Mitigation: scope lightweight adapters and defer heavy kernel changes to separate RFC
Risk: Feature teams overloaded and slow to adopt; Mitigation: provide staffed pairing sessions and a one-click runbook import script
Risk: Canary automation interacts poorly with autoscaling; Mitigation: run canaries in isolated capacity pool and validate autoscaler behavior in staging
metrics_to_track: Time-to-detect (TTD) and time-to-mitigate (TTM) for incidents during rollout
Number of teams onboarded to the template
deliverables: SLO definitions + registry entry (yaml) for pilot routes
Dashboards and alert configs in Grafana/Datadog
Runbooks (detection, mitigation, postmortem) per pilot service
Canary rollout checklist + small automation playbook
Onboarding template and short demo video
next_steps: Schedule kickoff workshop and invite stakeholder reps (owner: Aisha) — by 2026-02-18
Run telemetry inventory sprint (owner: Marisol) — complete by 2026-02-25
Prototype synthetic probe for route group A (owner: Ethan) — POC by 2026-03-04
Draft SLOs and circulate for review (owner: Liam) — review cycle complete by 2026-03-08
notes:
Quick thoughts and open questions below:
- We should avoid locking SLO thresholds to absolute latency numbers that don't account for model upgrades — consider relative baselines per model family.
- Decision needed: treat streaming chat latency vs final-text latency as separate SLOs or a combined experience SLO? Recommend two SLOs initially.
- Budget: small reserved infra for canaries (estimate 4 GPU-hours/week) — platform to confirm with infra finance.
- Owner ask: each stakeholder to nominate a backup for the weekly sync.
